proof_body:
by
  intro K L _ _ _ _ _ p _ h
  haveI : NoZeroSMulDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L) :=
    ⟨fun {c x} hc => by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def] at hc
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hc with h1 | h1
      · exact Or.inl (NumberField.RingOfIntegers.algebraMap.injective K L (by simpa using h1))
      · exact Or.inr h1⟩
  exact ⟨Ideal.card_primesOverFinset_le_finrank _ K L h, fun P _ _ => ⟨Ideal.ramificationIdx_le_finrank _ K L P, Ideal.inertiaDeg_le_finrank _ K L P h⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (K L : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [Field L] [NumberField L] [Algebra K L] (p : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) [p.IsMaximal], p ≠ ⊥ → (IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset p (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)).card ≤ Module.finrank K L ∧ ∀ (P : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p], p.ramificationIdx P ≤ Module.finrank K L ∧ p.inertiaDeg P ≤ Module.finrank K L
